snippet.title: Acornia: Mirror Worlds | Reveal Trailer | Coming 2027
snippet.description:
Acornia: Mirror Worlds is coming to Steam, Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S in 2027, wishlist it now: https://acorniagame.com/

Run your family’s dessert shop in one dimension and battle angry spirits in the other in this bake-and-brawl management adventure. 🥧

Bake delicious treats, grow your shop, explore dungeons, and restore the once-thriving village of Acornia as Alva, a determined squirrel with bottomless cheek pouches — perfect to serve sweet treats... or to spit them at spirits' faces!

Follow us on socials for updates:
- https://twitter.com/AcorniaGame 
- https://www.instagram.com/acorniagame/ 
- https://www.reddit.com/r/AcorniaMirrorWorlds/
